items.title: Johnny Varro interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001
items.q: In fact there was a little thing going there with Spiegel and Phil Napoleon trying to match me and Cindy, and Cynthia together.

ctx.x: You probably wonder — you played with him a number of times I guess?

Oh he used to come into Nick’s back in the 50s, the early 50s. Spiegel used to come in and sit in and Cindy would be with him. In fact there was a little thing going there with Spiegel and Phil Napoleon trying to match me and Cindy, and Cynthia together.
